description: This file defines the PhpExtensionsValidator class, which performs validation checks for specific PHP extensions (like 'xdebug' and 'openssl') within the Drupal package manager context. It implements event subscription to trigger validation during certain package management events.

classes.name: PhpExtensionsValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks for required PHP extensions and issues warnings or errors based on their presence, primarily used within Drupal's package management system.

methods.name: isExtensionLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific PHP extension is loaded, with special handling when running inside tests.

methods.name: validateXdebug
methods.description: Adds a warning if the 'xdebug' extension is enabled, due to potential performance issues.

methods.name: validateOpenSsl
methods.description: Adds an error if the 'openssl' extension is not enabled, highlighting a security risk.

methods.name: insideTest
methods.description: Determines if the validator is running inside a test environment.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events and corresponding methods to invoke for validation during package management processes.
